halves.name: Open-Book Golden Retriever
halves.desc: You love out loud: warm, gentle, all in, and mostly by your own rulebook.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared.
You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: Vibes-Based Wanderer
halves.desc: You follow your curiosity wherever it goes. Rules and timelines are suggestions; the vibe decides.

axes.line: New city, new plan, new try. The unknown pulls you in.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You'll break any rule for your people, except the one where you tell them what hurt.
Freedom is your superpower. It's also your favorite excuse.
hearts: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
I travel light, and I live true.

tags.name: Bends rules for good reasons
tags.heart: I look at the person, not the form.
tags.sting: You think people made the rules, so the rules should bend for people.

youToldGenii.said: Worked around it quietly. Nobody got hurt.
The friend having the awful month. They need tonight.
Draw six. Stacking is the best part of Uno.

tags.name: Head over heels, eyes open
tags.heart: I love all the way, and I know where the door is.
tags.sting: You say you're independent. You still want to be in every part of their day.

youToldGenii.said: Stuck together all night. Basically one person with two phones.
Envy. Someone else got the good version of them.
If they're free, I'm suddenly free too.

tags.name: Always has a flight tab open
tags.heart: Going far is how I see myself clearly.
tags.sting: You love everything here. You're more scared of only ever seeing here.

youToldGenii.said: Go. Pack tonight, learn the bus map when I land.
The brand-new one. Day one, I'm googling everything.
I pick the restaurant none of us has tried.

tags.name: Here, scroll my phone
tags.heart: Letting you all the way in is how I feel safe.
tags.sting: You say you have nothing to hide. You're quietly hoping they have nothing to hide either.

youToldGenii.said: Handed my best friend my phone: "Write the follow-up. Make it chill."
Type mine into their phone before they finish the sentence.
Always. Come find me. I'm the dot at 4%.

tags.name: Still loading, and that's fine
tags.heart: My timeline is mine to write.
tags.sting: You're not against settling down. You just hate being rushed.

youToldGenii.said: Double-tapped. Forgot it by the next video.
Don't you dare. Finding out is the fun part.
Changed plans four times. Happier every time.

calls.line: You've said 'technically' and then done the nice thing anyway.
Your person's name is the first one your phone suggests.
You've learned 'thank you' in a language you don't speak yet.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Landlord. I help. Rent is my dishes for a week.’ Put on the spot, you'd go with: ‘Wait to see who steps up, then fill the gaps.’

said.text: Landlord. I help. Rent is my dishes for a week.
